relTest.notes: Report captions: close-ups take the finding before them, moisture readings (💧 Reading), clearer wording for notes like "roof decking noted with…", no more wrong library matches, numbered rooms without "the", tidier bullet names, and a warning when a caption names another elevation or bedroom. Scope of work: rooms collapsed with filters (category, documents/interview/on site, open only), differences between the interview and the documents with Add or Ignore, repeated rooms merged, Match rooms, and renaming into an existing room asks first. Attic: Above areas are offered, and only rooms with ceiling staining are added.
